messages:
anya: Quick smoke runs for zephyr-6b v2 finished. Posting the numbers + commands we used and follow-ups. TL;DR: promising latency at batch=1 with 4-bit quant, but p95 with long context needs more work.
perf-bot: CI: zephyr/bench/initial succeeded — artifacts: https://ci.redwood/zephyr/1793509876 (logs + trace).
kevin: can you paste p50/p95, tokens/sec, and which quant/batch you used?
anya: ran on a single A100-80GB, batch=1, kv-cache=on, quant=4bit (q4f). Command: ```./bench_runner --model zephyr-6b-v2 --quant q4f --batch 1 --max-seq 2048 --kv-cache true --tokens 1024``` Results (median over 5 runs):
```
context=2048  p50=62ms  p95=180ms  tokens/sec=240  GPU_mem=34.2GB  peak_gpu=75%
context=4096  p50=110ms p95=420ms  tokens/sec=110  GPU_mem=37.8GB  peak_gpu=88%
```
anya: baseline comparison (flan-6b @ same config): p50=55ms p95=160ms tokens/sec=270 — so zephyr is ~10-15% slower but within expected for its opt layers.
rachel: is the run with prefix caching (kv) enabled for the 4k runs? curious about memory scaling.
anya: yes kv-cache enabled for both. For 4k we used incremental decode test (batch=1, chunked prefill) — script: ```scripts/run_prefill.sh --model zephyr-6b-v2 --seq 4096 --quant q4f```
infra-bot: GPU utilization summary for run 1793509876: avg_util=72%, mem_free_avg=9.8GB, io_wait negligible.
devon: if p95 for long context >2x baseline we should open a perf-regress ticket. Did you diff kernel selection vs previous model?
anya: looked at kernel profiles — attention fused kernel falls back to slower path above 3k tokens for this build. I filed ticket: https://issues.redwood/INF-2219 (zephyr kv perf) and attached traces.
kevin: can you also try dynamic batching up to 8 (latency SLO at 100ms) and post delta? curious if throughput/latency sweet spot exists.
anya: scheduling dynamic-batch run now, ETA ~1h. Will post summary here. :eyes:
rachel: also run a quality check on the quantized model (eval harness small set) before we publish variant. If quality regresses >2% on rouge/accuracy, don't publish.
anya: ack — ran small eval, delta <1.2% across our sample prompts. Attached eval snippet in CI artifacts.
kevin: SGTM. If dynamic batching keeps p95 <200ms for typical 512-token responses, we can mark the variant as "quant4-lowlatency" candidate.
anya: summary/action items:
- created INF-2219 for kv perf above 3k tokens (devon assigned)
- dynamic-batch test running (will post results)
- small eval shows <1.2% quality delta (rachel to eyeball full eval)
- recommend staging publishing of `zephyr-6b-quant4-lowlatency` behind A/B for 48h if dynamic-batch numbers look good :tada:
kevin: thanks, nice work.
anya: thanks team. ping @rachel @devon for next steps.
perf-bot: Note: archived raw perf traces at s3://redwood-ci/zephyr/1793509876/traces.tar.gz
infra-bot: Reminder: these runs used a single tenancy A100; results may vary on smaller hardware or multi-tenant Dedicated pools.
